summary: RUSTSEC-2026-0512 still applies to the dependency tree
details: DNSSEC validation accepted an unrelated signed RRset as the answer (hickory-proto). hickory-proto 0.25.2 is in the default node through iroh 0.95.1. cargo audit on 2026-11-13 says no fixed upgrade is available. The minimal feature tree measured on this host does not contain hickory. This is not a Bitcoin consensus bug. Reporter credit is pending consent. This entry was taken from cargo audit, not from a private report.
